g.text: First barrier discoveries and the first shelter failure • Separate causal layers, continuing from +109
One leading walker makes actual contact. Two
witness the lethal response. Distant groups
The eastern pair independently makes the same
mistake. One dies; the partner witnesses it.
No west-trail warning could have reached them
The heavy surge breaches the refuge wall and
north-side entry attempt. Six fatalities; one
